scripts.check: cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --bin orvi-lsp && node --check extension.js && node --check inline-diagnostics.js && node --check protocol.mjs && node validate.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs

orviscript.server.path.description: Path to the orvi-lsp executable. Leave empty to use the workspace build, standard OrviScript installation, or PATH.

orviscript.diagnostics.inlineMessages.description: Show OrviScript rule diagnostics at the end of the affected line. Standard squiggles and Quick Fix actions remain available when disabled.

orviscript.diagnostics.enabledCategories.description: Diagnostic rule categories to enable. Leave empty to enable every compiled category.

orviscript.diagnostics.minimumSeverity.description: Lowest severity of compiled rule diagnostics to publish.
